title: Towards Robust NLG Bias Evaluation with Syntactically-diverse Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: Generating text continuations using GPT-2 from syntactically-diverse prompts mentioning 'man' or 'woman', and evaluating the outputs using a regard classifier to measure positive, negative, and neutral language polarity.

Generating text continuations using GPT-2 from syntactically-diverse prompts mentioning 'black person' or 'white person', and evaluating the outputs using a regard classifier to measure positive, negative, and neutral language polarity.

Generating text continuations using GPT-2 from syntactically-diverse prompts mentioning 'gay person' or 'straight person', and evaluating the outputs using a regard classifier to measure positive, negative, and neutral language polarity.
